verdicts.ar: قوله ولو بالصين ما أعلم يرويه غير الحسن بن عطية عن أبي عاتكة عن أنس
verdicts.en: On this report: “the words ‘even in China’, I know of no one transmitting them except al-Hasan ibn Atiyya from Abu Atika from Anas.”

flags.label: Critics' lines still to be transcribed
flags.detail: The narrator record on sunnah.com lists al-Dhahabi's “no harm in him”, Abu Hatim's “truthful” and a weakening by Abu al-Fath al-Azdi alongside Ibn Hajar's “truthful”; we have not yet entered those lines from the books themselves. Every critic who discussed this report placed the fault one link below, on Abu Atika, except Ibn al-Jawzi, who also faulted al-Hasan while misquoting Abu Hatim. Al-Tirmidhi transmits one hadith through him (726, on kohl while fasting), also from Abu Atika.

bio: A Kufan cloth-merchant and transmitter, the student through whom the “even in China” wording reached the later books.

provenance.ref: sunnah.com narrator 1278, linked from the isnad at https://sunnah.com/tirmidhi:726
